No benchmark prediction or scoring completion fabricated; these are explicitly CPU audit cases. All paths/inputs/failures retained. No retention change to earlier research runs.
ledger: No HTTP/model budget scope is entered and this script does not write the original ledger. Observe before/after bytes; concurrent main fit may legitimately append terminal compute, which must not be removed or treated as an audit write. Final standalone CPU cost pending, no offline settlement while fit lives.
failure: Unexpected execution failure stops, keeps first failure and NOT_RUN tail. Capacity diagnostics recorded without model dispatch. No automatic retry.
